span.p:
One model answers alone
→ Can sound very confident
→ Sometimes hallucinates / invents facts

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Multiple AI models receive the same question
at the same time

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stage 1 – Independent answers
Each model creates its own response
No influence from others

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stage 2 – Anonymous peer review
Every model reads all answers
without knowing who wrote which
→ ranks them honestly

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stage 3 – Chairman synthesizes
One smart model combines
the strongest parts + highest ranked ideas
→ creates final, careful answer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
You receive one polished response
→ noticeably fewer hallucinations
→ more balanced & trustworthy

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Persistent 24/7 version
→ Connect via Telegram / Discord etc.
→ Remembers past conversations
→ Lives in your pocket like a friend

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The system tracks which models perform best
on your kinds of questions
→ Automatically re-ranks the council
→ Your personal AI slowly gets smarter
